name: Alesia Canafax
why: Her own studio class portrait, the only individual frame of her in the archive; the alternative is a candid at the university centre candy counter.

src.label: 1981 Talisman, p. 359, sophomore class portraits (Blake-Doukpolagha). The names run in blocks of nine down the right-hand column and each block is one row of nine portraits, left to right; Canafax opens the fifth block and is first in the fifth row. The grid checks out against the sexes and against Ronald G. Carnes, third in that block and the man in glasses third in the row. The 1982 Talisman group photograph of Associated Student Government, p. 241, names Alesia Canafax in its back row.
